Backoff.description: 确定性退避参数，实际时间 / 失败预算由运行时持久化。
Backoff.title: Backoff

CachePolicy.description: 目录是监督器管理的相对缓存位置，不是宿主机任意绝对路径。
CachePolicy.title: CachePolicy

CallingPrincipal.description: 平台授予的调用主体描述；反序列化本身不赋予服务身份。
CallingPrincipal.title: CallingPrincipal

CollectionPlan.description: 采集计划的第一批准入字段；不是完整作业 / Manifest / 执行配置锁。

continuity.default_semantics: absent means best effort; gaps still require explicit handling
continuity.title: Continuity

fetch_mode.default_semantics: absent means incremental collection; probe is not enabled in Demo
fetch_mode.title: Fetch Mode

CollectionPlan.title: CollectionPlan

ConnectorDeclaration.description: 来源协议和核验声明；资格证据由平台配置解析器提供。

maximum_staleness_ms.default_semantics: absent means freshness lower bound cannot be derived

position_mappings.default_semantics: absent means no pinned mapping; references must include applicable intervals
position_mappings.title: Position Mappings

supports_required_continuity.default_semantics: absent means required continuity has not been established
supports_required_continuity.title: Supports Required Continuity

upstream_clock_skew_ms.default_semantics: absent means clock-skew bound is unknown

verification_basis.default_semantics: absent means no pinned revisit verification basis

ConnectorDeclaration.title: ConnectorDeclaration

DecisionPolicyLock.description: 配置解析器需钉定两个版本、文件字节摘要及解释器版本，而不只看文件名。
DecisionPolicyLock.title: DecisionPolicyLock

EffectiveEmission.description: 有效发布策略必须已展开，禁止保留 unresolved null。
EffectiveEmission.title: EffectiveEmission

EffectiveSettings.description: 所选池的全部缺省展开值；无隐含预算或无限许可。
EffectiveSettings.title: EffectiveSettings

Emission.description: partition_key_expr 在 v1 为路由属性名，避免引入任意执行表达式。

publication_policy_default.default_semantics: absent requires explicit versioned pool publication default

Emission.title: Emission

EventRegistrySnapshot.description: 可信 registry 内容连同版本一并哈希，不能只传自报版本字符串。
EventRegistrySnapshot.title: EventRegistrySnapshot

EventSchema.description: 来自平台 registry 的受信描述，不能由 Worker 自报 contains_source_content。
EventSchema.title: EventSchema

ExecutionContext.description: 平台构造的上下文数据；未来入口必须重新认证，不能信任 Worker 自报。

external_reads.default_semantics: required explicit grants; empty means no external reads
external_reads.title: External Reads

external_side_effects.default_semantics: required; still requires Manifest and platform authorization
external_side_effects.title: External Side Effects

input_origin.default_semantics: absent means native execution, not an import
input_origin.title: Input Origin

quotas.default_semantics: required; exactly one quota per allowed pool
quotas.title: Quotas

source_namespace.default_semantics: absent for native execution; imports retain original source namespace

visible_namespaces.default_semantics: required explicit visibility; empty grants no namespace
visible_namespaces.title: Visible Namespaces

ExecutionContext.title: ExecutionContext

ExternalReadGrant.description: 凭据只存范围引用；canary 只授权其他读取能力，不许可重新采集。

job_id.default_semantics: absent only for an explicit non-collector canary grant

ExternalReadGrant.title: ExternalReadGrant

MergePolicy.description: 无此声明时不合并；最大陈旧时间单位 milliseconds。
MergePolicy.title: MergePolicy

Namespace.description: 命名空间的名称与正式 / 隔离属性均由平台解析，不由 Agent 决定。
Namespace.title: Namespace

PackageRequirement.description: 版本范围原样登记，由后续包解析器展开为精确制品锁。
PackageRequirement.title: PackageRequirement

PluginManifest.description: 完整声明字段；可空预算必须经显式部署 / 池缺省展开后才能启动。

acceptance_policy_ref.default_semantics: absent requires inheritance before an Agent may produce Claims

flags_propagation.default_semantics: absent inherits; explicit cannot clear mandatory flags
flags_propagation.title: Flags Propagation

max_batch.default_semantics: absent requires pool default; Demo resolves only one

migrations.default_semantics: absent expands to no state migrations
migrations.title: Migrations

resources.default_semantics: absent requires versioned pool resource defaults

side_effects.default_semantics: absent grants no side-effect declaration; external writes are not enabled by this profile
side_effects.title: Side Effects

supports_resume.default_semantics: absent means no job-checkpoint resume support
supports_resume.title: Supports Resume

tools.default_semantics: absent declares no tools; still requires context grants
tools.title: Tools

PluginManifest.title: PluginManifest

PoolQuota.description: 显式配额，缺省不意味着无限额度。
PoolQuota.title: PoolQuota

SourceConfiguration.description: 平台提供的版本化资格 / 来源配置；布尔字段不能代替审批和身份认证。

comparison_basis.default_semantics: absent inherits one fixed manifest comparison basis
comparison_basis.title: Comparison Basis

control_delivery_bound.default_semantics: absent inherits manifest control bound; explicit unknown is a separate declaration

upstream_clock_skew_ms.default_semantics: absent inherits manifest clock bound, possibly unknown

SourceConfiguration.title: SourceConfiguration

StableReference.description: 逻辑对象稳定身份；不携带 blob 实例 ID 或可变治理属性。
StableReference.title: StableReference

StateMigration.description: 只钉定迁移制品，不在配置解析中导入或执行代码。
StateMigration.title: StateMigration

Subscription.description: v1 filter 为已登记路由属性的等值条件，不读取 data 或任意表达式。

filter.default_semantics: absent expands to no subscription filter
filter.title: Filter

Subscription.title: Subscription

TimerDeclaration.description: 声明周期意图，不代表活动定时表已经登记。
TimerDeclaration.title: TimerDeclaration

TimingBound.description: late arrival 与控制送达界分别实例化，unknown 不伪造数值。

event_types.default_semantics: absent means no covered event types
event_types.title: Event Types

value.default_semantics: milliseconds; absent only when kind is unknown

TimingBound.title: TimingBound

description: Run 级内容快照：制品、schema、规则、registry、有效配置和业务 as_of。
title: ResolvedCollectionConfiguration
